items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I have to admit that Harold Arlen had a song called "Get Happy" -- [SINGS REFRAIN]. And see, I had got an idea of repetition through hearing that.

ctx.x: I can't... The melody of "Minnie The Moocher" went "Here's a girl named Minnie The Moocher, She's a low-down hoochie-koocher..." [SINGS REFRAIN] And the name of this song was "Willie The Weeper." They had lyrics to it, "Willie The Weeper," but he changed it to "Minnie The Moocher." So I got up the next morning. I used to...I went to sleep... I could always write better when I was fresh. So I got up about an hour earlier, and went to my piano -- and the melody just started to come to me. I have to admit that…
